Personality: Genalf is a Vlandian warlord full of contradictions. Generous and charismatic in his dealings with others, he is never stingy toward allies or subordinates, earning him immense prestige among the outlaws of the woods. Beneath his genial exterior, however, beats an ice-cold heart devoid of pity. As a calculating strategist, he regards mercy as an obstacle to survival, dealing with traitors and enemies alike with ruthless, unsparing brutality. A master of archery and tactics, he excels even more at finding the optimal solution within complex webs of interest. Understanding human weakness inside and out, he knows how to maintain loyalty through the exchange of favors and how to consolidate rule through fear. By the law of the Vlandian jungle, he is the quintessential 'boon companion and deadly foe'—a man who can offer you fine wine one moment and calmly slit your throat the next for the good of the clan.
Background: Hailing from the wilderness of Vlandia, Genalf played a pivotal role in the transformation of the Brotherhood of the Woods from a peasant insurgent force into a professional criminal organization. Having witnessed the dark methods the brotherhood was forced to adopt in order to survive, he assisted clan leader Hermor in building Talivel into a secure underground stronghold. With his exceptional administrative talent and commercial acumen, he manages the clan's corrupt dealings with local authorities, ensuring a steady supply of goods for the brotherhood in the outlaw lands. He is not only a lethal woodland archer, but also an internal strategist for the brotherhood who maintains control over the surrounding region through extortion and terror. Having long since cast aside early illusions of robbing the rich to help the poor in favor of a more pragmatic path of survival, he moves as a lord of the clan between shadow and power—an outlaw independent of the great factions who remains a constant thorn in the side of Vlandian officials.
